cases.title: Senior Frontend Engineer
cases.description: We build a design-system-driven analytics product. You will own our React and TypeScript front end, lead table and chart components, and mentor two mid-level engineers. Next.js, TanStack Query and Vitest are our daily tools. 6+ years of frontend experience required.

cases.title: Senior React Engineer
cases.description: Join a product team shipping a B2B dashboard. Day to day: React 18, TypeScript, Next.js app router, performance work on large data grids. You should have shipped complex UI at scale and be comfortable reviewing others' code.

cases.title: Staff Frontend Engineer
cases.description: Lead the architecture of our customer-facing web app (React, TypeScript, Next.js). You will set standards, run design reviews and pair with product. Experience with schema-driven forms and tables is a strong plus.

cases.title: Senior Frontend Developer (TypeScript)
cases.description: Our team of 12 builds a scheduling platform used by 40k businesses. Stack: TypeScript, React, TanStack Query, Playwright. You will own features end to end, from API contract to polished UI. Senior level, 5+ years.

cases.title: Senior Full-Stack Engineer (React-heavy)
cases.description: 70% frontend, 30% Node backend. React and Next.js on the front, TypeScript throughout, Postgres behind. We want someone who cares about component APIs and accessibility.

cases.title: Lead Frontend Engineer
cases.description: Lead a squad of four frontend engineers on a fintech web app. React, TypeScript, Next.js, design tokens. You will own technical direction, hiring input and delivery. 7+ years, with experience leading.

cases.title: Senior Frontend Engineer, Data Visualization
cases.description: Build interactive dashboards with React and TypeScript: virtualized tables, charts, filters, saved views. Next.js and TanStack Query on our stack. You enjoy performance profiling and clean component design.

cases.title: Senior Web Engineer (React)
cases.description: We are a distributed product company. As a senior web engineer you will build and maintain our React/TypeScript front end, improve our build tooling, and help define our testing approach with Vitest and Playwright.

cases.title: Senior Frontend Engineer - Design Systems
cases.description: Own our component library built on React and TypeScript, documented in Storybook and consumed by five product teams. Next.js experience helps. Seniority: senior, 6+ years.

cases.title: Senior Software Engineer, Frontend
cases.description: Work on a collaborative editing product in TypeScript and React. Focus on state management, rendering performance and offline behavior. TanStack Query and Next.js in use. Senior-level ownership expected.

cases.title: Senior Frontend Engineer (Next.js)
cases.description: We run a headless commerce storefront on Next.js and TypeScript. You will improve Core Web Vitals, build checkout flows in React, and mentor juniors. 5+ years frontend.

cases.title: Principal Frontend Engineer
cases.description: Set the frontend direction for a 30-engineer organisation: React, TypeScript, Next.js, micro-frontends. You will write less code and unblock more people. Long record of shipping large React applications required.

cases.title: Senior Backend Engineer (Go)
cases.description: Design and run high-throughput Go services on Kubernetes. Deep experience with gRPC, Postgres tuning and distributed tracing. No frontend work in this role.

cases.title: Junior Frontend Developer
cases.description: Entry-level role for someone with 0-1 years of experience. You will fix small UI bugs in a React codebase under close supervision. Training provided.

cases.title: iOS Engineer (Swift)
cases.description: Build native iOS features in Swift and SwiftUI. Strong knowledge of UIKit, Core Data and App Store release processes required. Android experience is a plus.

cases.title: Machine Learning Engineer
cases.description: Train and deploy ranking models with PyTorch. You will own the feature pipeline, offline evaluation and serving infrastructure. Python and distributed training experience required.

cases.title: Senior DevOps Engineer
cases.description: Own our Terraform, AWS and CI/CD estate. On-call rotation, incident response and cost optimisation. Strong Linux and networking background required; no application development.

cases.title: Senior Java Developer
cases.description: Maintain core banking services in Java 17 and Spring Boot. Oracle databases, SOAP integrations and on-site presence three days per week.

cases.title: Senior Product Designer
cases.description: Lead UX for our consumer app: research, flows, prototypes in Figma. You will partner with engineers but not write production code.

cases.title: Embedded Firmware Engineer
cases.description: C and C++ firmware for low-power sensors. Experience with RTOS, bootloaders and hardware bring-up required. Relocation support offered.

cases.title: Data Engineer
cases.description: Build ETL pipelines with Airflow, Spark and dbt on a Snowflake warehouse. SQL mastery and data modelling experience are essential. Python is the main language.

cases.title: Security Engineer
cases.description: Run application security reviews, threat modelling and penetration tests. Familiarity with OWASP, SAST tooling and incident handling. Scripting in Python.

cases.title: Frontend Intern
cases.description: Three-month internship for students. Work on small React components with a mentor. Part-time, stipend only.

cases.title: Senior Ruby on Rails Engineer
cases.description: Own backend features of a Rails monolith: ActiveRecord, Sidekiq, Postgres. Limited frontend work (ERB templates, some Stimulus). Ruby experience of 6+ years required.
